name: Secure Electronic Technology PLC
source: Secure Electronic Technology Plc, NGX ticker NSLTECH and also listed by the board as SET Plc. Audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, held in the NGX disclosure library. The filing is a scan with no text layer, so every figure was read from it by OCR at 200 dpi on 25 September 2026, and each printed identity was checked before the rows were written

rows.label: Capital Expenditure
rows.derivedFrom: printed purchase of property plant and equipment plus printed purchases of intangible assets, both negative, so this row is stored negative

rows.label: Financing Cash Flow
rows.note: printed repayment of borrowings of 20,000,000 in FY2025 and a net inflow of 25,153,570 in FY2024

note: Rebuilt 25 September 2026 from the audited FY2025 report of the issuer, statement of cash flows page 22. Every row is a printed figure. Operating plus investing plus financing cash flow equals the printed total cash movement in both years, and adding that movement to the printed opening cash reproduces the printed closing cash, which is also the cash and cash equivalents line of the balance sheet at the same date. Figures are in naira, stored absolute. This replaced an interim file that carried a HY 2026 operating cash flow of 52,740,000 with the investing and financing rows empty; that file is in the backup directory named in the audit log.
